notes.title: Teeto Goes Tiny With Hub World Update!
notes.notes: [p]Teeto is going tiny as part of the Tiny Teams Festival, running from today, August 7th till Thursday, August 14th![/p][p][/p][p]Experience our Teeto demo like never before with a brand new hub, the Baby Michael Room, where you can see and interact with the Michaels you’ve rescued![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/354bfbb0768063bf1e943c988df6540a9391a936.png"][/img][/p][p]This demo update also includes two new unlockable costumes, Unicorn… [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/1c2451971f1b9f2d573e8f8d3d90546ae9f4758e.png"][/img][/p][p]…and Luchador! ¡Viva la lucha![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/b8570f0013a7dc9bc25550136c50bc1e358389ce.png"][/img][/p][p]Expect general optimisations, animation tweaks and minor bug fixes too, to add extra sparkle to this Steam demo update. [/p][p][/p][p]…What, you thought that was all? Teeto’s demo will also be streamed LIVE by Boba and Martyn of the Yogscast crew on Monday, August 11th as part of their “We Love Platformers” showcase! See the full schedule below and come say hi as they jump into our world on Twitch or YouTube.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44839914/1b4945645ffe8caf894080bb5e827105c55afe8e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]So go tiny this August with Teeto, exclusively with Tiny Teams! [/p][p][/p][p]Join us on [u][url="https://discord.gg/8G5rpF25GQ"]Discord[/url][/u] to celebrate this demo update, chat during the livestream and to share your feedback on this new update.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, love y’all. [/p][p]EPG. [/p]

notes.title: Minor demo update!
notes.notes: [p]Minor update introducing some different types of stars to collect with each level having a star threshold you have to meet as an extra objective for 100%'ing that level. Even though currently in the demo you can't buy any of the costumes or upgrades yet (CAUSE YOU GET IT ALL FOR FREE YOURE WELCOME)[/p][p][/p][p]We've also spruced up a tiny bit of the UI making things a little bit juicier (who doesn't love that).[/p][p][/p][p]Apparently with some controllers it was bugging out and causing the game to go into co-op mode when trying to jump about. This has been patched. Before it was picking up that if Player 2 was pressing A, they could automatically join the game. We've dropped this for now while we figure out what's up, so for now you can enable co-op in the start/pause menu :)[/p][p][/p][p]If you notice anything else - please let us know! We've got a Discord for easy access: [url="https://discord.gg/cgYdDNgkbh"]https://discord.gg/cgYdDNgkbh[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Love ya'll [/p][p]EPG[/p]

notes.title: Demo update is live!
notes.notes:
This update is the biggest yet - packed with improvements based on community feedback and our own mission to deliver the most joyful experience possible. Here’s what’s new:
[list]
[*] Brand New Camera System: Enjoy buttery-smooth platforming with our new following camera system, designed to keep gameplay intuitive and comfortable.
[*] Major Optimizations: We’ve tightened up performance across the board, ensuring a more responsive and stable experience on a wider range of hardware.
[*] Updated Visuals: Sharper visuals, better lighting, and more vibrant environments bring the world of Teeto to life like never before.
[*] Quality-of-Life Fixes: From gameplay polish to smoother movement and interaction, we’ve made dozens of small (but mighty!) adjustments to improve the overall feel of the game.
[*] New Animations & NPC Interactions: Teeto’s world is livelier than ever, with more personality-packed animations and fresh dialogue from the charming characters you’ll meet.
[/list]
     
Also made a separate demo page on Steam so if you enjoyed it - support us with a lil review!
